verdict.rationale: Manufact ships an official MCP server that exposes the platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs and observability as tools. Users can therefore manage the product in natural language from Cursor, Claude or another MCP client, and authorization hands back a ready-made starter prompt. The natural-language layer comes from the external AI client, not from a built-in command interface, and there is no hands-on evidence of how well it works. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations work reliably via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
